segments.speaker: CSEC
segments.text: Our security audit found several critical issues. First, we have hardcoded credentials in our codebase. This must be fixed immediately.

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: I'll audit the entire codebase and remove all hardcoded secrets. We'll use environment variables and AWS Secrets Manager for credential management.

segments.speaker: AUDIT
segments.text: We also need to comply with GDPR and CCPA. All user data must be encrypted and we need clear data retention policies.

segments.speaker: CSEC
segments.text: Thomas, implement AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data at rest. For data in transit, enforce TLS 1.3.

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: I'll implement encryption this week. I also recommend we run OWASP security tests and fix any vulnerabilities found.

segments.speaker: AUDIT
segments.text: We need a comprehensive data classification and retention policy. Can you draft this by next Friday?

segments.speaker: CSEC
segments.text: Also, implement multi-factor authentication for all admin accounts. This is non-negotiable.

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: MFA will be ready by end of week. I'm also setting up automated security scanning in our CI/CD pipeline.

segments.speaker: AUDIT
segments.text: We should schedule a follow-up audit in 30 days. All critical issues must be resolved by then.

segments.speaker: CSEC
segments.text: Agreed. Thomas, send weekly progress reports. Jennifer, prepare the compliance checklist.
